messages:
priya: Heads up — sales forwarded a couple of enterprise asks about surfacing a customer-set priority in Console + API. They want clear owner signals and status updates. Can we scope?
marcus (sales): Yep. Customer A (FinReg) and Customer B (AdOps) both want their account teams to be able to mark an intake as `customer_urgent` and have that affect backlog scoring + trigger an email to the assigned PM.
elaine (support): I saw Zendesk tickets. Support currently adds a ticket label but it doesn't flow into product intake. Customers want support-driven escalation to land in product.
ben (eng): Quick question — do we persist this on the canonical intake object or treat it as a transient tag? Persisting means schema + migration.
marcus (sales): They prefer canonical. Needed for SLA commits and reporting. Also want programmatic updates from their ticketing systems.
priya: Proposal: add `customer_priority` enum on the intake API: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `urgent`. Map to internal score: low=1, medium=3, high=6, urgent=10. This feeds backlog weight and triggers workflows.
tara (product-ops): Also add a Console badge and emit a webhook event `intake.priority_changed` so partners can react.
ben (eng): API sketch:
```
POST /intakes
{
  "title": "Optimize tenant routing",
  "customer_priority": "high",
  "source": "sales:z123"
}

Event payload: {"event":"intake.priority_changed","intake_id":123,"old":"medium","new":"high"}
```
We'll need validation + RBAC (only org admins or linked sales/support service accounts can set `urgent`).
elaine (support): For support integration, we can add a one-click "Escalate to product" button that sets priority and creates the intake if it doesn't exist.
marcus (sales): Also want an optional human-readable reason field to show next to the badge, e.g. "Regulatory freeze on onboarding."
priya: Add optional `customer_priority_note` string. UX: small badge + tooltip with note + last-updated-by.
ben (eng): Dedupe note — if multiple intakes represent the same ask we should collapse while preserving sources' priorities. Suggest dedupe key: normalized title + product_area + customer_tenant_id. If conflicts, choose the highest priority and merge notes (append with source attribution).
tara (product-ops): I'll draft an Ops playbook for priority disputes (when PM must respond, how to de-escalate) and a canned reply template for sales/support. Suggested canned message: "Thanks — we've linked your request to intake #123 and marked it as High. We'll update status here... :eyes:"
priya: Launch criteria (phase 1 + 2):
- Phase 1: API + DB + webhook + canned response templates + support escalation button
- Phase 2: Console badge + priority history UI + dedupe integration that favors max priority
- RBAC: `urgent` restricted to approved roles
- Monitoring: telemetry for priority changes and webhook delivery failures
ben (eng): Rough estimate: Phase1 = 4wks (API, DB, webhook) + 2wks (docs + canned responses). Phase2 = +1wk for UI badge + +1wk for dedupe integration.
marcus (sales): Can we do a phased roll? Phase1 is API & programmatic set + support escalation. Phase2 is UI + dedupe rules.
priya: Agreed. Priorities: phase1 must support programmatic set + manual escalation from support. Phase2 adds dedupe/fallthrough.
elaine (support): I'll own support docs and the canned template; I'll coordinate Zendesk webhook mapping with integrations.
tara (product-ops): I'll write the Ops runbook and the dispute resolution flow.
ben (eng): I'll open the GH epic and initial design doc and share a staging mock by EOW.
priya: Action items:
- ben: GH epic + design doc (due in 3 business days)
- tara: ops playbook stub (2 business days)
- elaine: support template + webhook mapping (3 business days)
- marcus: post exact customer examples from Customer A/B here
I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue to confirm scope.
marcus (sales): I'll post example tickets shortly.
intake-bot: New task created: PROD-1234 "customer_priorities: phase1" assigned to ben, prio P1.
priya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll keep requester comms short and set expectations for phased delivery.
